deadline.value: PhD applications for Fall are due January 1, 2027 (11:59pm).
deadline.quote: Geosciences PhD Doctorate Fall 2027 1278 January 1, 2027 January 1, 2027

gre_general.value: GRE General Test scores are not considered or accepted.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Test scores will not be considered or accepted in application materials.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are advised to email a potential advisor before applying; an advisor conversation is not a requirement.
supervisor.quote: Once you have identified a faculty member who would make a good potential advisor for you, send them an email expressing your interest in their lab

funding.value: Full-time PhD students in good standing are typically fully funded through RAs and TAs, covering stipend, tuition and health insurance.
funding.quote: Full time PhD students, in good standing, are typically fully funded through a combination of research assistantships and teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: A conferred bachelor's degree in earth/space sciences, biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics or engineering is the stated requirement.
entry_route.quote: Conferred Bachelor's degree in one of the earth or space sciences or in biology, chemistry, physics, mathematics, or engineering.

notes: A limited number of PhD application fee waivers are available to domestic and international applicants; requests close December 15, 2026.
